issues.description: Numeric threshold in the WHERE condition for Aufgabe 07 does not match the problem specification. The problem statement (problem_statement.md) requires selecting municipalities with more than 75,000 male or more than 75,000 female inhabitants. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql) uses a threshold of 7,500 (einwohner_m > 7500 OR einwohner_w > 7500) on line 3, which will return many more rows and contradicts the stated requirement. This semantic mismatch will confuse students about the expected magnitude of the filter and produce incorrect results for the task.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the WHERE clause in solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql to use the correct threshold of 75000. For example: WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000. Ensure the solution aligns exactly with the numeric condition stated in the problem description.
